name: Zed
toolNameForm: bare tool names, sanitized to [A-Za-z0-9_-] and cut to 64; <server_id>_ prefixed only on a collision
nameMangling: anything outside [A-Za-z0-9_-] becomes _, truncated to 64 (V, crates/agent/src/thread.rs#L76-L98, #L4323-L4342)
notes: settings.json is JSONC (parse_json_with_comments). context_servers is untagged: stdio {command, args, env, timeout, enabled}, HTTP {url, headers, timeout, oauth, enabled}; no type and no source key (V, crates/settings_content/src/project.rs#L506-L604). The macOS path is ~/.config/zed, not ~/Library (V, crates/paths/src/paths.rs#L122-L140). No env-reference expansion was found (NF), so tk refuses an entry that needs a variable for Zed.
sources: github.com/zed-industries/zed at v1.25.3: crates/paths/src/paths.rs, crates/settings_content/src/project.rs and settings_content.rs, crates/agent/src/thread.rs, docs/src/ai/mcp.md (lane C research, 27 Oct 2026)

gate.where: none: tk connect writes its MCP file only
